title: Shape the home page: start-here variants
question: Three ways to open the home page with a start-here path for QA leaders, each followed by the chronological feed. Lock one, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: A note from Ish
options.lineage: a handwritten note left on the board
options.thesis: The path is three inline links inside a short first-person note; the feed follows.
options.viewport: "Hi, I'm Ish." with avatar, a three-sentence note whose links are steps 1-3, RSS/LinkedIn and topic chips, then the newest posts.
options.risk: The note's wording is my draft; it must be rewritten in your voice and kept current.

options.label: Vertical lesson plan
options.lineage: a lesson plan chalked down the side of the board
options.thesis: The path runs down one chalk spine beside the feed, each stop saying why a leader should read it.
options.viewport: Left column: "A lesson plan for QA leaders" with three numbered stops on a chalk line; right column: the dated feed and topic chips.
options.risk: Two columns stack on phones, so the path pushes the feed below the first screen.

options.label: Path that remembers you
options.lineage: a teacher ticking off a student's progress
options.thesis: Returning readers see their progress: read steps ticked in chalk, the next one marked, new posts flagged.
options.viewport: "If you lead QA, start here." with three framed steps (two ticked, one 'up next') and "Welcome back: 2 of 3 read", then the feed with new posts flagged.
options.risk: Needs ~1KB of JS and browser storage; first-time visitors see the plain path.
